description:
Nestled in a peaceful side street near the city centre and local amenities, this two-bedroom end terrace property boasts a versatile layout suitable for a small family or professional couple. As you step inside, you are welcomed by a vestibule and entrance hallway leading to a generously sized living room and a sitting room, which could serve as an additional bedroom if needed. The modern high gloss fitted kitchen features contrasting worktops and some integrated appliances, adding a stylish touch to the home.

Upstairs, a convenient three-piece bathroom awaits. Outside, a private rear yard offers a tranquil space for outdoor enjoyment. This residence presents a great opportunity for first-time buyers or investors seeking to enhance their portfolio. Do not miss the chance to own this adaptable and well-located property. Contact us today to arrange a viewing.
